body: Did you miss ARE We F*cked? An Anti-AI-Doomer's Perspective last week? Ryan Castillo brought the 757tech Pop-up Meetup to The HIVE by City of Virginia Beach on Thursday night for a straight-talking look at where AI actually earns its keep — and where you are still better off with your own brain. It was a huge turnout, and the conversation kept going long after the last slide.

Ryan's through-line was practical rather than apocalyptic: when to reach for AI versus your awesome human self, and a starting list of which tools are worth using for which jobs. No doom, no hype — just what holds up in real work.

Thanks to Ryan for speaking, to The HIVE for hosting, and to everyone who turned out and kept the questions coming. Pop-up Meetups are built for exactly this kind of room — details on the next one at 757tech.org.
We are always looking for topic and speaker suggestions — let us know if you have thoughts! Just hit reply, or come find us in Discord.

quote.text: This is what Pop-up Meetups are for — get good people in a room, skip the hallway-track small talk, and let the discussion actually go somewhere. This one did exactly that, and then some.
